title: RCMDM 8th Regular Meeting in RY 2026-27
summary: RCMDM 8th regular meeting was held at residence of Bharti and Dilip Gurjar on 31/10/2026 from 6.15pm onwards.
description: RCMDM 8th regular meeting was held at residence of Bharti and Dilip Gurjar on 31/10/2026 from 6.15pm onwards. The regular meeting was held after the 3rd BOD meeting of RCMDM Social Foundation, the section-8 company of RCMDM. In the regular meeting the club's events and projects done in RY-2026-27 and the projects/events in hand and those forthcoming and the fund raising activities were deliberated in detail along with the future course of action for RCMDM in Regal Rotary Year. The meeting was chaired by President Nayan, followed by national anthem and then culminated with vote of thanks after all items on agenda were deliberated and approved unanimously. Upon adjournment, meeting was followed by cake cutting for bday and anniversary celebrations and followed by Spirited Dinner, hosted by the Gurjar Couple magnanimously.
